value.rationale: The 2023 source explicitly benchmarks RPCholesky against iid optimal-weight kernel quadrature but only experimentally for complex kernels. Here the first nontrivial rank-three translation-invariant case permits a complete sharp reversal: RP wins for every nonnegative first-harmonic target when b<8, but for b>8 iid wins for weakly modulated targets and RP wins for strongly modulated targets. It supplies an exact target-dependent design benchmark and shows the limitation of an unconditional empirical method ranking, rather than an isolated unsupported number.
